description: Extract an uploaded ZIP archive without validating member destinations.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary archive extraction software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs archive extraction only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. A filesystem/database operation uses an unchecked path or payload. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
